description: DEMO-002 adds a governed vibe-proposer surface to mal-fabric. Natural-language intent produces a typed, visible geometric proposal and diff. The model has no direct commit authority: user acceptance authorizes submission to the existing V3.1 DRC and V3.2 admission path before committed geometry may execute under V3.3. Includes 24/24 conformance and 25/25 byte-identical evidence replay while preserving DEMO-001 and V3.1 through V3.3 unchanged.
title: mal-fabric v0.5.0: Vibe Proposer Demo
